about: Reviewed name corrections, keyed by the stable POI ID (osm:node/123). Every entry needs the exact OSM ID, a source URL that confirms the name for THIS place, and the review date. kind: official_name | common_name | translated_description. Entries without a valid source_url or reviewed date are ignored. See docs/NAMING.md.

example_not_active.note: Copy into the overrides list only after checking the ID on openstreetmap.org and the source.
